_doc_writable: Optional per-connection 'writable' flag. Defaults to true when absent (all existing configs continue to work). Set to false to refuse all mutating tools on a connection — see CONTEXT.md D-07.
_doc_legacy_mcpServers: Earlier versions of this example file documented an 'mcpServers' wrapper for the Claude Desktop launcher config. That format belongs in the MCP client's config (e.g. ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json), not in graylog-mcp's own ~/.graylog-mcp/config.json which only holds the 'connections' registry.
